purpose: Category-to-capability map for the 'Capability Discovery, Routing, and Governance' category. Agents use it to pick the right provider, worker and approval class for a requested PC task without re-deriving policy.

capability-discovery-routing-governance.notes: This Skill Tool implements the category itself: inventory, self-test, routing, boundary, approval, reversible planning, provenance, parsing.

core-native-build.notes: Bind build output to a clean directory; never build over an artifact being inspected.

windows-cross-build.notes: Cross-built binaries should be verified on the real target worker before handoff.

dotnet-managed.notes: Pin the SDK with a global.json; legacy Mono builds stay in a disposable worker.

java-python-node-desktop.notes: Lock dependency files before builds; no registry writes during verification.

binary-inspection.notes: Read-only metadata and header parsing only. Disassembly of owned or licensed binaries.

debugging-profiling.notes: Crash dumps may contain personal data; scope collection and retention explicitly.

compatibility-wine-proton.notes: One dedicated prefix per application; snapshot before prefix changes.

virtualization-emulation.notes: Snapshot first; keep guests on isolated networks unless networking is approved.

packaging-signing.notes: Signing and publishing always require a human approval record and key custody confirmation.

archives-media.notes: Extract into a fresh directory; treat archive paths as untrusted (no traversal, no overwrite).

local-data.notes: Open application databases read-only and copy before migrating.

networking-tls.notes: Allowlisted endpoints only; no credential forwarding.

security-supply-chain.notes: Scan owned code and permitted images; database refreshes are networked actions.

containers-linux-desktop.notes: Container execution is privileged: require approval and a disposable runtime.

approval_reminders: Read-only inspection never needs approval but must still record evidence.
Any write to a system path, registry, driver, service or firmware needs a snapshot and an approval record.
Signing, publishing, financial and credential actions always need a human role from asset-approval-policy.json.
